paper_claims.claim: WSA1 achieves 93.1% success rate on RoboTwin2.0 benchmark across 50 bimanual tasks, outperforming all open-source models.
On 7 real-world robot tabletop tasks, WSA1 achieves an average +20% to +46% performance boost over state-of-the-art RFMs.
WSA1 achieves data-efficient pre-training using only 6,000 hours of demonstration data, including just 1,000 hours from real robots.
WSA1-B obtains 97.4% and WSA1-L obtains 98.2% average success rate on the LIBERO benchmark.
Ablation on RoboTwin2.0 shows 2D visual thinking provides +16% gain (60% to 76%), 3D world prediction provides +15% gain (60% to 75%), and full WSA reaches 80% (scratch) and 93% (with pretraining).
